title: The rusersd daemon must be disabled on AIX.
check_content:
From the command prompt, execute the following command: 
# grep "^rusersd[[:blank:]]" /etc/inetd.conf

If there is any output from the command, this is a finding.
fixtext:
In "/etc/inetd.conf", comment out the "rusersd" entry by running command: 
# chsubserver -r inetd -C /etc/inetd.conf -d -v 'rusersd' -p 'udp'

Restart inetd:
# refresh -s inetd
VulnDiscussion: The rusersd service runs as root and provides a list of current users active on a system. An attacker may use this service to learn valid account names on the system. This is not an essential service and should be disabled.
